purpose: Sanitized derived-evidence baseline distilled from one Microsoft 365 -> Gmail authentication test on 2026-05-30. Reusable as an input artifact for future lab-mailbox-backed reaction-timing tests, mailbox-authentication tests, and sender-provenance scaffolding work. Source of truth for the derived auth values consumed by tests/fixtures/reaction_timing/stage_a_lab_mailbox_authpass.json.

mailbox.status: lab-only; not a final brand sender; not client-facing

test_event.reply_path_status: Gmail reply back to the Microsoft mailbox succeeded
test_event.source_log_entry_title: Microsoft Lab Mailbox Header Test Recorded

arc.note: core/scoring/email_authentication_detector.py parses only spf/dkim/dmarc; arc is preserved here for observability and future use only

microsoft_outbound_classification.note: Outbound classification observed on the Microsoft side. Not part of the inbound Authentication-Results surface the runtime scoring detector parses; recorded here as observability only.

gmail_delivery_placement.note: First external send from the lab mailbox landed in Gmail's spam folder. No current Stage A detector path consumes delivery-placement signals; recorded for observability only.

raw_header_completeness: NOT stored. Only the derived fields above and the assembled Authentication-Results header value are preserved, per the 2026-05-30 PROJECT_ACTIVITY_LOG boundary that explicitly chose not to store the full raw header. The full raw Microsoft -> Gmail Received: chain remains outside the repo by operator instruction.
consumable_as: Authentication-Results header value for the runtime SPF/DKIM/DMARC scoring detector (core/scoring/email_authentication_detector.py); see tests/fixtures/reaction_timing/stage_a_lab_mailbox_authpass.json for one consumer (REACTION_TIMING_TEST_LOG record rxt-2026-05-30-001).
Real lab-mailbox sender identifier (mailbox.address) for future fixtures that need an authenticated sender backed by lab observation rather than an .example placeholder.
Stable derived-evidence reference for activity-log entries and PROJECT_HANDSHAKE state that need to point at a tracked baseline instead of restating SPF/DKIM/DMARC details inline each time.
not_consumable_as: Raw Received: chain input for the sender-provenance / geo-velocity detector or its cheaper-proof corpus (raw chain is intentionally not stored).
Real production traffic sample of any kind.
Authorization for a Microsoft 365 integration or any cross-domain product surface.
boundary_statement: Lab-only evidence baseline. Not a production fixture, not a buyer-facing artifact, not a client-facing claim, not a sender-provenance proof sample, not an authorization for a Microsoft 365 integration, and not a measure of MSP or underwriter usefulness. The Stage A wedge per VISION.md is unchanged by the existence of this file.
